name: University Love
source:
You will play as a 21 years old male who is accepted in an University. Not being to able to make new friends in College since you had social anxiety, you decide to overcome this and make new friends during your University life.

Make and improve your new friendships.

Each character has their own backstories and personalities.

[from [url=https://thecodingavian.itch.io/university-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名被大学录取的21岁男性。由于你有社交焦虑，因此无法在大学结交新朋友，你决定克服这一点并在大学生活中结交新朋友。

结交并增进新的友谊。

每个角色都有自己的背景故事和个性。

[来自[url=https://thecodingavian.itch.io/university-love]Itch.io[/url]]
